modules.name: FreeCAD
modules.summary: Core application module used to create and recompute the document that owns a Sketcher::SketchObject.

modules.name: Sketcher
modules.summary: Sketcher App module used by headless scripts to create constraint records for Sketcher::SketchObject instances.

modules.name: Part
modules.summary: Geometry module used to create curve primitives before adding them to a sketch.

symbols.summary: Create the document that owns the headless sketch workflow.
Create a Sketcher::SketchObject by type id and internal object name.
Append Part geometry to a sketch and return the geometry index used by constraints.
Append Sketcher.Constraint records that reference existing sketch geometry indices.
Create a typed Sketcher constraint such as Horizontal, Distance, or Radius.
Recompute the document after Sketcher geometry and constraints are added.

objects.name: App::Document
objects.behavior: Owns the sketch object and exposes recompute so a headless script can validate final document state.

objects.name: Sketcher::SketchObject
objects.behavior: Document object created with type id Sketcher::SketchObject; stores ordered Geometry and Constraints collections.

objects.name: Sketcher.Constraint
objects.behavior: Constraint value object constructed in the Sketcher module and stored on Sketcher::SketchObject.Constraints.

objects.name: Part.LineSegment
objects.behavior: Representative line geometry added to the sketch before horizontal and distance constraints are attached.

objects.name: Part.Circle
objects.behavior: Representative circular geometry added to the sketch before a radius constraint is attached.

properties.name: Name
properties.behavior: Stable internal object name supplied to Document.addObject and used by Document.getObject.

properties.name: Geometry
properties.behavior: Ordered geometry collection; addGeometry return values are indices into this collection.

properties.name: Constraints
properties.behavior: Ordered constraint collection populated by addConstraint and verified after recompute.

properties.name: Type
properties.behavior: Constraint kind, such as Horizontal, Distance, or Radius.

properties.name: Value
properties.behavior: Numeric value used by dimensional constraints such as Distance and Radius.

examples.title: Create and verify a constrained sketch headlessly
examples.summary: Creates a document sketch, adds line and circle geometry, attaches horizontal, distance, and radius constraints, recomputes, and verifies state.

workbenches.name: Sketcher Workbench Guide
workbenches.summary: Headless Sketcher automation starts from the Document API, then uses Part geometry and Sketcher constraint constructors without activating the GUI workbench.

anti_patterns.name: sketcher-gui-command-reliance
anti_patterns.summary: Do not activate the Sketcher GUI workbench or call Gui.runCommand in headless recipes.
anti_patterns.guidance: Create Sketcher::SketchObject with Document.addObject and call Sketcher App APIs directly so the recipe runs under FreeCADCmd.

anti_patterns.name: sketcher-wrong-object-type
anti_patterns.summary: Do not add generic Part geometry objects when the workflow needs an editable sketch.
anti_patterns.guidance: Use doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", name), then add Part geometry to that sketch with addGeometry.

anti_patterns.name: sketcher-unstable-geometry-index
anti_patterns.summary: Do not hard-code geometry indices without owning the geometry insertion order.
anti_patterns.guidance: Capture addGeometry return values and pass those indices to Sketcher.Constraint constructors.

anti_patterns.name: sketcher-invalid-constraint-arity
anti_patterns.summary: Do not reuse one constraint argument shape for every constraint type.
anti_patterns.guidance: Match constructor arguments to the selected constraint type, such as Horizontal(line_index), Distance(line_index, value), or Radius(circle_index, value).

anti_patterns.name: sketcher-skipped-recompute
anti_patterns.summary: Do not verify final sketch state before recomputing the owning document.
anti_patterns.guidance: Call doc.recompute() after geometry and constraints are added before making assertions about the workflow result.
